name: smwmusic-kid-icarus-the-angel-who-can-t-fly-underworld-remix
title: Kid Icarus - The Angel Who Can't Fly ~ Underworld (Remix)
description:
𝒟𝑜 𝓎𝑜𝓊 𝒽𝑒𝒶𝓇 𝓉𝒽𝒶𝓉? 𝒟𝑜 𝓎𝑜𝓊 𝒽𝑒𝒶𝓇 𝓉𝒽𝑒 𝓅𝑒𝑜𝓅𝓁𝑒'𝓈 𝒸𝒽𝑒𝑒𝓇𝓈?! 𝒯𝒽𝑒𝓎'𝓇𝑒 𝒸𝑒𝓁𝑒𝒷𝓇𝒶𝓉𝒾𝓃𝑔 𝓉𝒽𝑒 𝓇𝑒𝓉𝓊𝓇𝓃 𝑜𝒻 𝓉𝒽𝑒 𝒢𝑜𝒹𝒹𝑒𝓈𝓈 𝒫𝒶𝓁𝓊𝓉𝑒𝓃𝒶!

Did a remix of the Underworld stage theme from Kid Icarus. Just played through Uprising for the first time recently (and loved it) so I thought I'd arrange the series' main theme. Pretty sick NES theme, but super unfitting for a stage that take place in what's basically the Greek mythology version of Hell (I mean, even Skyworld would fit here better than this theme).

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. G# Major (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. A Major (Reaper Pitch... you know why I'm dubbing it that)
